facts: Official Landmarks3D plugin streams high-detail GLB meshes and suppresses overlapping extrusions.
Orbis 3D Landmarks remains Private Preview and requires a key with that explicit entitlement.
No Astana-specific landmark coverage was established in the examined official material.
Direct origin documentation already differs from the Exa snapshot: current methods include updateConfig/applyConfig/getConfig/resetConfig, not setDisplayMode.
findings.quality: Current implementation vendor documentation; direct-origin HTTP 200 verified. Capability/access evidence is strong; no independent Astana geometry evidence.

facts: Official Style Editor matrix explicitly assigns building landmarks to HERE SDK Navigate only.

The vector schema contains has_landmark and has_3d_model flags but does not establish delivery to the browser SDK or Astana model presence.
findings.quality: Primary current feature matrix and data schema, direct-origin matrix verified; do not conflate mobile SDK capabilities or general Kazakhstan coverage with web landmark delivery.

facts: Official Google country table lists Kazakhstan with 2D map tiles only and no Maps JavaScript 3D support.
Cesium ion's global catalog combines distinct datasets: world terrain and OSM buildings do not supply detailed captured Astana architecture.
Native Cesium integration remains useful with a separately authorized municipal or commercial mesh.
findings.quality: Official country table directly checked; explicit country/product distinction is stronger than global marketing counts.

findings.status: Commercial candidate without verified Astana coverage
facts: Vexcel product is a real 3D Tiles reality mesh, distributed commercially through Cesium ion Self-Hosted.
The inspected official announcement emphasizes United States, Europe, Australia and Japan; it does not identify Astana.
An Astana-specific footprint/sample/license quote is still required, so it cannot be selected on global marketing coverage alone.
findings.quality: Vendor partnership announcement, dated 2024-06-25; establishes product format but incomplete/current coverage needs provider confirmation.

findings.status: Not a new detailed Astana mesh source
facts: The actual Astana data catalog offers OSM vector tiles, raster imagery, hillshading and contour lines.
No detailed Astana textured mesh or I3S/3D Tiles dataset is advertised on that page.
A Cesium-compatible imagery basemap is not a 3D city dataset.
findings.quality: Primary exact-city product catalog; absence limited to the inspected advertised catalog.

findings.status: No qualified Astana detailed web renderer found
facts: Bing Maps for Enterprise has retired free Basic accounts; existing enterprise customers can continue through 2028-06-30.
Current Azure render coverage documents raster/vector road tiles, not a 3D city mesh guarantee, and its published country table does not list Kazakhstan.
A 2022 Microsoft staff Q&A separates extrusions/custom models from Bing textured cities; it is historical context, not conclusive current feature evidence.
No official Astana photogrammetry coverage or supported route-capable detailed web integration was found.
findings.quality: Current official retirement/coverage docs directly checked; historical Q&A explicitly treated as dated supporting context.

findings.status: Native free-license candidate, owned key and GPS-use eligibility unresolved
facts: Prior project research directly verified Bayterek and alem.ai geometry on provider-hosted API v3 maps.
Current v3 quickstart explicitly requires an owned API key with configured HTTP Referer.
Kazakhstan free-use terms allow eligible publicly available projects and retain restrictions/attribution requirements; account-specific eligibility still applies.
Native YMapFeature/YMapMarker primitives can preserve Qala's external Valhalla polyline and selected-place interaction.

Kazakhstan section 5.1.3 excludes real-time monitoring of people, vehicles or other objects and dispatch from free use. Personal navigation may differ from monitoring; obtain provider confirmation or applicable commercial terms before claiming Qala's GPS flow qualifies for free use.
Quickstart key link points to developer.tech.yandex.com, currently redirecting to Yandex ID authentication for maps-api/console; no anonymous issuance found.
findings.quality: Primary docs/terms plus earlier direct SDK screenshot evidence in astana-3d-sdk.md; no owned key or fresh runtime success in Qala.

findings.status: Permitted limited embedding, not native Qala replacement
facts: Map Constructor documents no-key saved interactive maps using script embedding; omitted key removes search, route-building and panorama controls.
Its documented parameters are saved-map ID, container, dimensions, language and scroll behavior; no public dynamic arbitrary-geometry/selection bridge is documented.
The ordinary share widget can embed a route, but provider documentation says it redraws the route at viewing time rather than guaranteeing Valhalla geometry.
Detailed 3D availability/parity of Constructor was not verified; do not assume it inherits consumer 3D.
findings.quality: Official supported interface documentation, directly checked for Constructor; no unsupported interception of generated map internals.

findings.status: Old FAQ does not override current keyed MapGL documentation
facts: Older official FAQ/help pages say maps need no key, but describe older APIs/widgets.
Current API Platform documentation explicitly requires demo/subscription keys for map APIs; current RasterJS terms likewise charge per raster tile and impose key limits.
No examined supported credential-free 3D MapGL route/pin integration was found.
Current owned-account demo issuance path is Platform Manager Dashboard > Create a Demo Key > name > Create; one-time, one month.
findings.quality: Both old and current primary pages are retained to expose the contradiction; current product-specific documentation receives greater weight.
